verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source Python library installed and run locally (pip package), supporting local LLMs via transformers/ollama and local sandboxed code execution via Docker, meaning the entire agent stack can run on user-controlled infrastructure with no mandatory SaaS dependency. CLI tools and local model support further confirm it's designed for self-hosted operation. Missing for 10: explicit deployment/server-hosting guide or infra docs for hosting it as a service beyond local script execution.
